say:2:1510245001:1.text: These are the Wildborn's sacred tablets and beast-hide scrolls. Every miracle recorded by our priestesses in the past is written here.
say:2:1510245001:1.source_cn: 这是雅库伯尔的泥石板和兽皮卷，历代巫祭长老记录的神迹都...

say:5:1510245004:1.text: I'll teach you how to write the sacred words. From now on, you must walk beside the Hunting God, revealing his will to Wildborn and carrying his mighty voice to the people.
say:5:1510245004:1.source_cn: 老朽会教你写字，以后你要常伴狩猎神左右，向雅库伯尔揭示...
say:5:1510245004:1.male: I'll teach you how to write the sacred words. From now on, you must walk beside the Hunting God, revealing his will to Wildborn and carrying his mighty voice to the people.
say:5:1510245004:1.female: I'll teach you how to write the sacred words. From now on, you must walk beside the Hunting Goddess, revealing her will to Wildborn and carrying her mighty voice to the people.

say:7:1510245006:0.text: Now, use your head and remember my words.
say:7:1510245006:0.source_cn: 现在，用你的头脑，从这里开始记起。

say:8:1510245007:1.text: During our ancient Blood Moon rite, the Wild Moon, the Herdmaster, our great Hunting God himself pardoned our sacrifice and showed mercy.
say:8:1510245007:1.source_cn: 此次血月献祭，雅库伯尔之月，兽群之主——伟大的狩猎神，...
say:8:1510245007:1.male: During our ancient Blood Moon rite, the Wild Moon, the Herdmaster, our great Hunting God himself pardoned our sacrifice and showed mercy.
say:8:1510245007:1.female: During our ancient Blood Moon rite, the Wild Moon, the Herdmaster, our great Hunting Goddess herself pardoned our sacrifice and showed mercy.

say:9:1510245008:0.text: Not only that, he even <style="highlight">deferred his sacred slumber</style> for the Wildborn.
say:9:1510245008:0.male: Not only that, he even <style="highlight">deferred his sacred slumber</style> for the Wildborn.
say:9:1510245008:0.female: Not only that, she even <style="highlight">deferred her sacred slumber</style> for the Wildborn.

choice_prompt:11:1510245008.text: Not only that, he even <style="highlight">deferred his sacred slumber</style> for the Wildborn.
choice_prompt:11:1510245008.source_cn: 不仅如此，<male>他</male><female>她</female>甚至为雅库伯尔强行<style=highlight>中断了神圣的休眠</style>。
choice_prompt:11:1510245008.male: Not only that, he even <style="highlight">deferred his sacred slumber</style> for the Wildborn.
choice_prompt:11:1510245008.female: Not only that, she even <style="highlight">deferred her sacred slumber</style> for the Wildborn.

say:12:1510245009:1.text: Ah, you must be testing me again.
say:12:1510245009:1.male: Ah, you must be testing me again.
say:12:1510245009:1.female: Ah, you must be testing me again.

say:13:1510245010:1.text: Every child knows that the herds thrive and multiply in spring, then migrate and rest when winter comes. You, Herdmaster, must also sleep when the time is right.
say:13:1510245010:1.source_cn: 兽群会在春天繁衍活跃，也会在秋冬迁徙安眠。您是兽群之主...
say:13:1510245010:1.male: Every child knows that the herds thrive and multiply in spring, then migrate and rest when winter comes. You, Herdmaster, must also sleep when the time is right.
say:13:1510245010:1.female: Every child knows that the herds thrive and multiply in spring, then migrate and rest when winter comes. You, Herdmaster, must also sleep when the time is right.

say:14:1510245011:1.text: In your long sleep, our cries usually go unanswered... Yet when the Halians struck, we were forced to awaken the sacred rites before their rightful time.
say:14:1510245011:1.source_cn: 在您的休眠期内，祭祀和祈祷极难被回应……但是，呼临人的...
say:14:1510245011:1.male: In your long sleep, our cries usually go unanswered... Yet when the Halians struck, we were forced to awaken the sacred rites before their rightful time.
say:14:1510245011:1.female: In your long sleep, our cries usually go unanswered... Yet when the Halians struck, we were forced to awaken the sacred rites before their rightful time.

say:15:1510245012:1.text: After all, if we missed last night's <style="highlight">blessing of the Blood Moon</style>, who knows how long we'd have had to wait for the next one?
say:15:1510245012:1.male: After all, if we missed last night's <style="highlight">blessing of the Blood Moon</style>, who knows how long we'd have had to wait for the next one?
say:15:1510245012:1.female: After all, if we missed last night's <style="highlight">blessing of the Blood Moon</style>, who knows how long we'd have had to wait for the next one?

choice_prompt:16:1510245012.text: After all, if we missed last night's <style="highlight">blessing of the Blood Moon</style>, who knows how long we'd have had to wait for the next one?
choice_prompt:16:1510245012.source_cn: 毕竟，要是错过昨晚的<style=highlight>血月吉象</style>，下一次不知道要再过多久。

say:17:1510245014:0.text: The ancient scrolls speak of your coming under the Blood Moon's gaze, bestowing favor upon the Wildborn. It's a great honor for us.
say:17:1510245014:0.source_cn: 据长卷记载，您往往伴随血月现身或降下赐福。那是雅库伯尔...
say:17:1510245014:0.male: The ancient scrolls speak of your coming under the Blood Moon's gaze, bestowing favor upon the Wildborn. It's a great honor for us.
say:17:1510245014:0.female: The ancient scrolls speak of your coming under the Blood Moon's gaze, bestowing favor upon the Wildborn. It's a great honor for us.

say:18:1510245015:1.text: That's the reason why you are also known as the Wild Moon. The Blood Moon is your symbol, the greatest of all omens.
say:18:1510245015:1.source_cn: 所以我们也称您为雅库伯尔之月，血月就是您的象征，是吉象之首。
say:18:1510245015:1.male: That's the reason why you are also known as the Wild Moon. The Blood Moon is your symbol, the greatest of all omens.
say:18:1510245015:1.female: That's the reason why you are also known as the Wild Moon. The Blood Moon is your symbol, the greatest of all omens.

say:19:1510245016:1.text: I sensed last night's Blood Moon in my visions, so I offered Gala as a sacrifice, praying for your answer...
say:19:1510245016:1.source_cn: 老朽卜算出昨夜可能是血月天象，所以奉加拉为祭品，在昨夜...
say:19:1510245016:1.male: I sensed last night's Blood Moon in my visions, so I offered Gala as a sacrifice, praying for your answer...
say:19:1510245016:1.female: I sensed last night's Blood Moon in my visions, so I offered Gala as a sacrifice, praying for your answer...

say:21:1510245017:0.text: You descended and did not take my soul.
say:21:1510245017:0.source_cn: 您降临了。没有取走加拉的灵魂。
say:21:1510245017:0.male: You descended and did not take my soul.
say:21:1510245017:0.female: You descended and did not take my soul.

say:22:1510245018:1.text: However, the Wildborn still need your blessing...
say:22:1510245018:1.source_cn: 但雅库伯尔需要您的赐福……
say:22:1510245018:1.male: However, the Wildborn still need your blessing...
say:22:1510245018:1.female: However, the Wildborn still need your blessing...

say:23:1510245019:0.text: Yes... Herdmaster, the tribe will hold a new blessing ceremony in a few days.
say:23:1510245019:0.source_cn: 是的……狩猎神大人，过几天部落会举办新的赐福仪式。
say:23:1510245019:0.male: Yes... Herdmaster, the tribe will hold a new blessing ceremony in a few days.
say:23:1510245019:0.female: Yes... Herdmaster, the tribe will hold a new blessing ceremony in a few days.

say:24:1510245020:1.text: The people shall lay another sacrifice before you. Should you deem us worthy, grant us the strength to endure and the spirit to never yield.
say:24:1510245020:1.source_cn: 众人会向您献上祭品，由您赐予我们绵延的气力和不屈的斗志...
say:24:1510245020:1.male: The people shall lay another sacrifice before you. Should you deem us worthy, grant us the strength to endure and the spirit to never yield.
say:24:1510245020:1.female: The people shall lay another sacrifice before you. Should you deem us worthy, grant us the strength to endure and the spirit to never yield.

say:25:1510245021:1.text: With your blessing, the Wildborn's hunts will never fail, and our spears will never dull!
say:25:1510245021:1.source_cn: 在您的赐福下，雅库伯尔的猎物将永远丰盈，我们的矛将永远锐利。
say:25:1510245021:1.male: With your blessing, the Wildborn's hunts will never fail, and our spears will never dull!
say:25:1510245021:1.female: With your blessing, the Wildborn's hunts will never fail, and our spears will never dull!

say:27:1510245022:1.text: We will seek your guidance tomorrow. It's growing late. You should get some rest.
say:27:1510245022:1.source_cn: 具体事项，我们明天再请示您……夜深了，您也该休息了。

say:27:1510245022:1.female: We will seek your guidance tomorrow. It's growing late. You should get some rest.

choice:26:2:3.text: I will do what I must.
